minimal_conflicts.evidence: Does not merge onto main at all: 4 conflicted files (package-lock.json, packages/app/next.config.js, useProjectConfigSave.tsx, CosmographProjectStore.ts). Its merge-base with main is b88b1a08 — its base branch stories_refactor moved on without it. GitHub calls it MERGEABLE because it is targeted at stories_refactor, not main.

One overlapping region of tests/unit/commands.test.ts: #577 adds four command ids to the sorted registry list, #616 rewrites the mock factory and adds 3D ids to the same file. Resolution is the union of both edits. Never binds on its own — every closed set containing #616 also contains #587, so the semantic conflict below fires first.

Four test files fail to load: store/commands/schemas.ts:89 calls z.enum(CosmographTraversalDirection) and the symbol is undefined at module-evaluation time — the stories refactor reshuffles the packages/cosmograph/src/cosmograph/index.ts barrel. Both PRs green alone; {575,576,577} passes and {587} passes.

#631's drift test tests/unit/params-ssot.test.ts asserts the committed ai/schemas/*.json match the TypeScript sources; #579 adds pointColorHopDirection, pointColorHopSeeds, the hopDistance strategy and TraversalDirectionType without regenerating them. Both PRs green alone; {575,576,579} and {575,576,631} both pass. Fix is mechanical: pnpm run ai:params-ssot after the merge.
